The biggest auto reward you have ever seen!
High up to 40K beans😱

Top Tier hosts, this is your chance to shine!
Go Live now and unlock Beans Back 🔥🔥🔥

📅 Event run dates: 
First Round: 9.5-9.7
Second Round: 9.13-9.14
Third Round: 9.20-9.21
August A Tier & Above Can Join!
⏰ Event run time: 12:00 PM - 5:00 PM AEST

lv.1 - if 6,000 beans recevied, get 1800 beans reward

lv.2 - if 12,000 beans received, get extra 2000 beans reward

lv.3 - if 20,000 beans received, get extra 2,700 beans reward

lv.4 - if 30,000 beans received, get extra 3,500 beans reward

lv.5 - if 40,000 beans received, get extra 4,000 beans reward

lv.6 - if 60,000 beans received, get extra 7,000 beans reward

lv.7 - if 90,000 beans received, get extra 11,000 beans reward

lv.8 - if 120,000 beans received, get extra 11,500 beans reward

The maximum reward you can receive is 43,500 beans
High up to 36% rebate and higher max beans reward!
💃 Go live in Solo or Multiguest Room as a host at least 20 mins within the hour, and you can do all event formats you like!
